purpose: What lib/control_plane_workflow_truth_reader.py accepts as an attested V5-F09 workflow census. The census chain (migration 0595, ops.workflow_census_record) is read back through the server's read-workflow-census verb and recomputed by lib/workflow_census_attestation.py; these values are never taken from the caller or the server.
writer_principals_note: The Worker-derived actor slug of the one writer: ops/workflow-census-writer.py runs from Joe's Mac under launchd and reaches record-workflow-census through ./run.sh call, whose LOCAL_TOKENS bearer the Worker resolves to joe-local. Any other session on that Mac shares that token, which is the stated limit of this attestation: it proves who recorded the census and when, not that the census is true.
writer_db_session_principals_note: The database login roles the deployed Worker's write connection uses (mcp-server/src/scac-exact-effects.js SESSION_PRINCIPALS, carr_writer bundle). A row recorded by any other login role -- a break-glass or owner connection -- is an unknown writer.
freshness_window_note: 26 hours for a daily writer (coordinator contract, 2026-09-24). If the writer is ever scheduled more often, set this to 2 x writer_cadence_seconds + 7200.
